record.bible_text: At the end<WH07093> of <FI>every<Fi> seven<WH07651> years<WH08141> thou shalt make<WH06213><WTH8799> a release<WH08059>.

And this <FI>is<Fi> the manner<WH01697> of the release<WH08059>: Every creditor<WH01167><WH04874><WH03027> that lendeth<WH05383><WTH8686> <FI>ought<Fi> unto his neighbour<WH07453> shall release<WH08058><WTH8800> <FI>it<Fi> ; he shall not exact<WH05065><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> of his neighbour<WH07453>, or of his brother<WH0251>; because it is called<WH07121><WTH8804> the LORD'S<WH03068> release<WH08059>. <RF>creditor: Heb. master of the lending of his hand<Rf>
Of a foreigner<WH05237> thou mayest exact<WH05065><WTH8799> <FI>it again<Fi> : but <FI>that<Fi> which is thine with thy brother<WH0251> thine hand<WH03027> shall release<WH08058><WTH8686>;

Save<WH0657> when there shall be no poor<WH034> among you; for the LORD<WH03068> shall greatly<WH01288><WTH8763> bless<WH01288><WTH8762> thee in the land<WH0776> which the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> giveth<WH05414><WTH8802> thee <FI>for<Fi> an inheritance<WH05159> to possess<WH03423><WTH8800> it: <RF>Save...: or, To the end that there be no poor among you<Rf>

Only if thou carefully<WH08085><WTH8800> hearken<WH08085><WTH8799> unto the voice<WH06963> of the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>, to observe<WH08104><WTH8800> to do<WH06213><WTH8800> all these commandments<WH04687> which I command<WH06680><WTH8764> thee this day<WH03117>.

For the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> blesseth<WH01288><WTH8765> thee, as he promised<WH01696><WTH8765> thee: and thou shalt lend<WH05670><WTH8689> unto many<WH07227> nations<WH01471>, but thou shalt not borrow<WH05670><WTH8799>; and thou shalt reign<WH04910><WTH8804> over many<WH07227> nations<WH01471>, but they shall not reign<WH04910><WTH8799> over thee.

If there be among you a poor man<WH034> of one<WH0259> of thy brethren<WH0251> within any<WH0259> of thy gates<WH08179> in thy land<WH0776> which the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> giveth<WH05414><WTH8802> thee, thou shalt not harden<WH0553><WTH8762> thine heart<WH03824>, nor shut<WH07092><WTH8799> thine hand<WH03027> from thy poor<WH034> brother<WH0251>:

But thou shalt open<WH06605><WTH8799> thine hand<WH03027> wide<WH06605><WTH8800> unto him, and shalt surely<WH05670><WTH8687> lend<WH05670><WTH8686> him sufficient<WH01767> for his need<WH04270>, <FI>in that<Fi> which he wanteth<WH02637><WTH8799>.

Beware<WH08104><WTH8734> that there be not a thought<WH01697> in thy wicked<WH01100> heart<WH03824>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, The seventh<WH07651> year<WH08141>, the year<WH08141> of release<WH08059>, is at hand<WH07126><WTH8804>; and thine eye<WH05869> be evil<WH07489><WTH8804> against thy poor<WH034> brother<WH0251>, and thou givest<WH05414><WTH8799> him nought; and he cry<WH07121><WTH8804> unto the LORD<WH03068> against thee, and it be sin<WH02399> unto thee. <RF>thought: Heb. word<Rf> <RF>wicked: Heb. Belial<Rf>

Thou shalt surely<WH05414><WTH8800> give<WH05414><WTH8799> him, and thine heart<WH03824> shall not be grieved<WH03415><WTH8799> when thou givest<WH05414><WTH8800> unto him: because<WH01558> that for this thing<WH01697> the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> shall bless<WH01288><WTH8762> thee in all thy works<WH04639>, and in all that thou puttest<WH04916> thine hand<WH03027> unto.

For the poor<WH034> shall never cease<WH02308><WTH8799> out of<WH07130> the land<WH0776>: therefore I command<WH06680><WTH8764> thee, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Thou shalt open<WH06605><WTH8799> thine hand<WH03027> wide<WH06605><WTH8800> unto thy brother<WH0251>, to thy poor<WH06041>, and to thy needy<WH034>, in thy land<WH0776>.<CM>

<FI> And<Fi> if thy brother<WH0251>, an Hebrew man<WH05680>, or an Hebrew woman<WH05680>, be sold<WH04376><WTH8735> unto thee, and serve<WH05647><WTH8804> thee six<WH08337> years<WH08141>; then in the seventh<WH07637> year<WH08141> thou shalt let him go<WH07971><WTH8762> free<WH02670> from thee.
And when thou sendest<WH07971><WTH8762> him out free<WH02670> from thee, thou shalt not let him go away<WH07971><WTH8762> empty<WH07387>:

Thou shalt furnish<WH06059><WTH8686> him liberally<WH06059><WTH8687> out of thy flock<WH06629>, and out of thy floor<WH01637>, and out of thy winepress<WH03342>: <FI>of that<Fi> wherewith the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> hath blessed<WH01288><WTH8765> thee thou shalt give<WH05414><WTH8799> unto him.

And thou shalt remember<WH02142><WTH8804> that thou wast a bondman<WH05650> in the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>, and the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> redeemed<WH06299><WTH8799> thee: therefore I command<WH06680><WTH8764> thee this thing<WH01697> to day<WH03117>.

And it shall be, if he say<WH0559><WTH8799> unto thee, I will not go away<WH03318><WTH8799> from thee; because he loveth<WH0157><WTH8804> thee and thine house<WH01004>, because he is well<WH02895><WTH8804> with thee;

Then thou shalt take<WH03947><WTH8804> an aul<WH04836>, and thrust<WH05414><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> through his ear<WH0241> unto the door<WH01817>, and he shall be thy servant<WH05650> for ever<WH05769>. And also unto thy maidservant<WH0519> thou shalt do<WH06213><WTH8799> likewise.

It shall not seem hard<WH07185><WTH8799> unto thee<WH05869>, when thou sendest him away<WH07971><WTH8763> free<WH02670> from thee; for he hath been worth<WH07939> a double<WH04932> hired servant<WH07916> <FI>to thee<Fi> , in serving<WH05647><WTH8804> thee six<WH08337> years<WH08141>: and the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> shall bless<WH01288><WTH8765> thee in all that thou doest<WH06213><WTH8799>.<CM>

All the firstling<WH01060> males<WH02145> that come<WH03205><WTH8735> of thy herd<WH01241> and of thy flock<WH06629> thou shalt sanctify<WH06942><WTH8686> unto the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>: thou shalt do no work<WH05647><WTH8799> with the firstling<WH01060> of thy bullock<WH07794>, nor shear<WH01494><WTH8799> the firstling<WH01060> of thy sheep<WH06629>.

Thou shalt eat<WH0398><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> year<WH08141> by year<WH08141> in the place<WH04725> which the LORD<WH03068> shall choose<WH0977><WTH8799>, thou and thy household<WH01004>.

And if there be <FI>any<Fi> blemish<WH03971> therein, <FI>as if it be<Fi> lame<WH06455>, or blind<WH05787>, <FI>or have<Fi> any ill<WH07451> blemish<WH03971>, thou shalt not sacrifice<WH02076><WTH8799> it unto the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>.
Thou shalt eat<WH0398><WTH8799> it within thy gates<WH08179>: the unclean<WH02931> and the clean<WH02889> <FI>person shall eat it<Fi> alike<WH03162>, as the roebuck<WH06643>, and as the hart<WH0354>.
Only thou shalt not eat<WH0398><WTH8799> the blood<WH01818> thereof; thou shalt pour<WH08210><WTH8799> it upon the ground<WH0776> as water<WH04325>.<CM>
